meta.title: Interest stream - INTCALC

statusLegend.PROVEN: static and cited: a statement in a scanned source names both ends
statusLegend.CANDIDATE: dynamic or inferred: rests on a naming convention, a run-time option or a target the source does not name

meta.outOfScope: The posting chain (POSTTRAN, TRANREPT) is not part of this stream; its jobs appear only as outside-stream users of the same datasets. No target code is produced in this step.

jobs.name: INTCALC
jobs.description: Reads the transaction-category balances and writes one interest transaction per balance with a non-zero rate, adding the account's interest to its current balance.

notes.text: Interest is computed as (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200 with no ROUNDED phrase.
1400-COMPUTE-FEES is an empty paragraph marked 'To be implemented'.

1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT runs when the account id changes; the ELSE branch that would run it after the last record sits inside a loop that ends as soon as END-OF-FILE is 'Y'. docs/BASELINE.md records this as legacy behaviour to keep.
Any file error path ends in 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM, which calls CEE3ABD with ABCODE 999.
Called by literal name from CBACT04C; no source member of this name is in the scanned estate. The off-host harness supplies a stub (tools/stubs/CEE3ABD.cbl); it is not part of the customer estate.

edges.label: DD TCATBALF
edges.basis: SELECT TCATBAL-FILE ASSIGN TO TCATBALF, OPEN INPUT, sequential READ; the JCL binds DD TCATBALF.

edges.label: DD XREFFILE
edges.basis: SELECT XREF-FILE ASSIGN TO XREFFILE, OPEN INPUT, READ ... KEY IS FD-XREF-ACCT-ID; the JCL binds DD XREFFILE.

edges.label: DD XREFFIL1
edges.basis: Inferred. No SELECT assigns XREFFIL1. XREF-FILE declares ALTERNATE RECORD KEY FD-XREF-ACCT-ID and is read by that key, and the JCL allocates the alternate-index path to a DD whose name is XREFFILE with its last character replaced by 1; the alternate index is KEYS(11,25), the offset and length of FD-XREF-ACCT-ID. That the run time opens the path through this DD is a platform convention, not a statement in the source.

edges.label: DD ACCTFILE
edges.basis: SELECT ACCOUNT-FILE ASSIGN TO ACCTFILE, OPEN I-O, random READ by FD-ACCT-ID; the JCL binds DD ACCTFILE.

edges.label: DD ACCTFILE
edges.basis: REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM ACCOUNT-RECORD after adding WS-TOTAL-INT to ACCT-CURR-BAL and zeroing the cycle credit and debit.

edges.label: DD DISCGRP
edges.basis: SELECT DISCGRP-FILE ASSIGN TO DISCGRP, OPEN INPUT, random READ, and a second READ with group 'DEFAULT' on status 23; the JCL binds DD DISCGRP.

edges.label: DD TRANSACT
edges.basis: SELECT TRANSACT-FILE ASSIGN TO TRANSACT, OPEN OUTPUT, WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD; the JCL binds DD TRANSACT to a new generation of the GDG AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN.

edges.label: PARM-DATE
edges.basis: PROCEDURE DIVISION USING EXTERNAL-PARMS; PARM-DATE is strung with a six-digit counter into TRAN-ID of every record written.

edges.label: FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE
edges.basis: Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP moves FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE into the timestamp written to TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS.

edges.label: DISPLAY
edges.basis: Inferred. The program issues DISPLAY with no UPON phrase and the step allocates DD SYSOUT; that DISPLAY output goes to that DD depends on the compiler/run-time output DD option, which is not in the estate.

exports.note: No line of the listing names INTCALC or COMBTRAN (0 matches), so CA 7 states no predecessor or successor for the stream. It does define CLOSEFIL, WAITSTEP and OPENFIL with different neighbours.

predecessors.basis: INTCALC waits on IN condition MONTHLY-InterestCalculation-CLOSEFIL (ODAT), which CLOSEFIL adds on completion.
predecessors.whatItDoes: One SDSF step that sends CEMT SET FIL(...) CLO for CICS files TRANSACT, CCXREF, ACCTDAT, CXACAIX and USRSEC to region CICSAWSA.

successors.basis: COMBTRAN waits on IN condition MONTHLY-InterestCalculation-INTCALC (ODAT), which INTCALC adds on completion.
successors.whatItDoes: SORT of TRANSACT.BKUP(0) concatenated with SYSTRAN(0) into TRANSACT.COMBINED(+1), then IDCAMS REPRO of that generation into TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS.
One SDSF step that sends CEMT SET FIL(...) OPE for the same five CICS files.

unproven.text: How often the folder runs. The folder and job descriptions say MONTHLY, but the definition carries every month flag, no day rule and RULE_BASED_CALENDARS NAME="*"; the calendar is not in the export. The store records frequency as unknown.

INTCALC against the posting job. POSTTRAN (CBTRN02C) opens TCATBALF and ACCTDATA I-O and builds the category balances INTCALC reads. POSTTRAN is in the CA 7 listing only; INTCALC is in the Control-M export only. No condition, trigger or dataset trigger orders one against the other.

INTCALC against the reload of its inputs. TCATBALF.STEP05-STEP15 delete, redefine and reload the category-balance file (CA 7 triggers job TCATBALF after CLOSEFIL2); DISCGRP.STEP05-STEP15 do the same for the disclosure-group file (Control-M folder DisclosureGroupsRefresh). Neither is ordered against INTCALC.

That the CICS files are closed before STEP15 opens the datasets. CLOSEFIL only submits modify commands; nothing in the JCL or the export waits for, or checks, the region's response. The folder has a wait job before OPENFIL but none between CLOSEFIL and INTCALC.
